stages.title: Stage 1: Village Street Stall 🟢
stages.subtitle: Meet local legends and master the basics

character.name: Dasan Ashaan
character.dialogue: Da mone, aadyam basic padikku. Oru adipoli round chappathi undakki kaanikk!

comments.start: Enthaa nokki nilkkunne? Chappathikkol eduthu pani thudangeda!
comments.good: Aaha! Ithu kollam. Nalla round aayittund!
comments.bad: Ayyo! Ithu chappathiyaano, Kerala map aano?
idle: Naduvil mathram nokkalle, side ilum nokkanam.
Slow aayalum kuzhappamilla... shape correct aakkanam.

character.name: Manar Mathai
character.dialogue: Hello! Oru important order aanu. Bhatura venam... pakshe nalla neat aaya oval shape-il!

comments.start: Hello! Ready alle? Oru nice oval aakki thaa!
comments.good: Aaha! Ithu kandittu enikku oru samadhanam undu!
comments.bad: Enthutaa ithu? Bhatura aano, mutta pottiyathaano?

stages.title: Stage 2: Highway Dhaba 🟡
stages.subtitle: Serve a lively crowd of travelers and legends

character.name: Anjooran
character.dialogue: Enikku vendath oru square chappathi aanu. Naal corners vyaktham aayirikkanam. Manassilaayo?

comments.start: Shradhichu cheyyanam. Naal corners. Athra thanne.
comments.good: Hmm. Ithu kollam. Naal corners nannayi vannittund.

character.name: Mangalassery Neelakandan
character.dialogue: Mundakkal Shekaran kaanatte. Moonnu corners ulla oru naan undakki kaanikk.

comments.good: Ha! Ithu thanne. Nalla sharp aayittund.

stages.title: Stage 3: Royal Palace Banquet 🔴
stages.subtitle: Impress royal guests with perfect creations

character.name: Nagavalli
character.dialogue: Vidhyaa... enikku oru manoharamaaya hridaya shape ulla chappathi venam. Nannayi sookshichu undaakku...

idle: Rand top curves... oru pointed bottom.

character.name: Dr. Sunny Joseph
character.dialogue: Unni, this is pure psychology! A smooth oval chappathi calms Nagavalli's mind instantly!

comments.start: Okay... let's begin. Tension venda, njan ivide undallo.
comments.good: Aha... now that's interesting. Nalla perfect oval!
comments.bad: Hmm... ee chappathikku swanthamayi oru personality undennu thonnunnu.
comments.timeLow: Time kuravaanu. Panic venda... just keep rolling.
idle: Relax... Chappathikkol aanu control cheyyendath, Chappathikkol ninne alla.
Melle roll cheyyu... curve maintain cheyyanam.
Mind calm aakki cheyyu. Shape automatic aayi varum.
Come on... I know you can do better than this.
Good... ippol athu oru proper oval aakkam.

character.name: Sethumadhavan
character.dialogue: Ella porattathinum oru lakshyam undaavum. Ee thavana, aa lakshyam oru five-pointed star aanu.

comments.start: Lakshyam clear aanu. Oru five-pointed star.
comments.good: Nannayi. Oro pointum clear aayi varunnund.

character.name: Pavanayi
character.dialogue: Pavanayi vannu! Ithu oru simple chappathi alla... secret crown shape aanu. Match cheythu kaanikk!

comments.good: Hmm... interesting. Pavanayi expect cheythathilum nannayi.
comments.bad: Ayyo... ithu crown aano, pottiya thoppiyaano?
